verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gmail has a REST API reference that documents endpoints and methods, such as POST users.messages/send. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console, or runnable examples. A static reference is related but is not the interactive capability the story asks for. Probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
